name: command-page
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Actual sequential graphic novel comic page asset, landscape 3:2 format, clean offwhite gutters, rough hand-inked brushwork and dense expressive hatching, natural anatomy, muted military navy black offwhite with selective blood-red accents, matte textured paper. Match attached reference character: young adult athletic soldier boxer, short dark hair and angular serious face. References are for identity and ink style only. No text anywhere, no captions, no lettering, no speech bubbles, no UI, no watermarks. A cinematic six panel military psychological thriller comic page, 2 rows of 3 panels. Sequential panels: 1 cold stern middle-aged commander behind a desk, officers in shadow beside him, maps and closed files; 2 close-up of commander's hand moving a soldier-shaped chess piece; 3 one fallen chess piece on the chessboard; 4 troops marching past a military truck in rain; 5 surveillance camera in an empty dark military hallway; 6 locked steel door with pinned photograph of a missing young soldier, photograph contains portrait only and no writing. Menacing quiet atmosphere, beautifully composed varied close-up and wide shots, coherent panel-to-panel continuity. No gore.
